target.title: fix(discord): add timeouts to directory lookup requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Discord directory, user allowlist, and channel allowlist lookup requests could hang indefinitely when Discord API fetches stalled before headers or during response body reads.

## Why This Change Was Made

Directory lookup callers now pass a focused 10 second timeout into the existing Discord API helper. The helper keeps the timeout alive through both `fetch()` and bounded response body reading, then clears it after the request attempt settles.

## User Impact

Discord configuration and lookup flows fail quickly when Discord API lookup calls stop responding, instead of blocking target resolution and directory browsing.

## Evidence

Exact head after normal merge from `upstream/main`: `c1e37ab5beb0c38a40632c43f4aa72bce32cc6a3`. The merge was a normal merge commit; no rebase or force-push was used.

Validation run:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/api.test.ts extensions/discord/src/directory-live.test.ts
-> 2 files passed, 22 tests passed

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/resolve-users.test.ts extensions/discord/src/resolve-channels.test.ts
-> 2 files passed, 21 tests passed

git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD -- extensions/discord/src/api.test.ts extensions/discord/src/api.ts extensions/discord/src/directory-live.test.ts extensions/discord/src/directory-live.ts extensions/discord/src/guilds.ts extensions/discord/src/resolve-channels.ts extensions/discord/src/resolve-users.ts
-> clean

node_modules/.bin/oxlint --threads=1 extensions/discord/src/api.ts extensions/discord/src/api.test.ts extensions/discord/src/directory-live.ts extensions/discord/src/directory-live.test.ts extensions/discord/src/guilds.ts extensions/discord/src/resolve-channels.ts extensions/discord/src/resolve-users.ts
-> clean
```

Controlled stalled Discord API proof run:

```text
node --import tsx --input-type=module
```

Harness shape: local HTTP server simulating Discord API responses, production `listDiscordDirectoryGroupsLive()` runtime path, production `fetchDiscord()` / `requestDiscord()` helper, and global fetch routed only from `https://discord.com/api/v10/*` to the local server. The proof uses normal HTTP fetches and a redacted Discord bot token; it does not use mocked response streams.

Observed behavior:

- Normal Discord directory lookup succeeds before and after the stalled cases.
- A channel lookup that stalls before response headers aborts in about 10 seconds and closes the server-side request/response.
- A channel lookup that stalls while reading the JSON response body also aborts in about 10 seconds and closes the server-side request/response.
- This exercises the production Discord directory lookup runtime and the shared Discord API helper rather than a unit-only mocked stream.

Known limits:

- This is controlled-network runtime proof, not a live Discord API outage reproduction.
- Remote Testbox/Crabbox proof was unavailable in this environment because no working `crabbox` binary was present; this used the documented narrow local fallback plus GitHub CI.
